content:
ani_cs: Quick sync for Nova preview cohort — kickoff in 3 days. Need final enroll list + one-sentence use case + top risk by EOD tomorrow. Sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheets/nova-enroll (do not change headers).

hugo_csm: Sending list in 30m. Two customers asked for SSO and one asked for IP allowlist.

cleo_enable: I can handle SSO walk-throughs during each kickoff. For IP allowlist please get the CIDR and approximate request rate so infra can pre-warm.

infra_ryan: IP allowlist OK, but pre-warm requires estimated RPS and burst. If they expect >50 RPS sustained, we should provision extra capacity.

ani_cs: Good catch. Hugo, add estimated RPS to the sheet. Also capture "primary_success_metric" and "trial_blocker" columns.

hugo_csm: Done. Marked one account as "procurement_pending" under trial_blocker.

notify-bot: Reminder set: "Nova enroll list due" on 2025-03-10 17:00 UTC.

cleo_enable: I'll draft a 15-min SSO admin checklist and a 5-min IP allowlist template. Posting to the drive by EOD.

ani_cs: For feedback, we'll run a short 3-question survey at day 7 and a 30-min interview at day 14. Please collect 3 canonical prompts per customer for the eval harness.

infra_ryan: Also confirm if customers need token-level traces. We recommend 12-hour windows only.

hugo_csm: Confirmed. I'll capture preferred trace windows.

ani_cs: Thanks team — I'll compile everything Monday AM and send kickoff invites. If blockers pop up, DM me.
